rows=subprocess.check_output(["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","status","--short"],text=True).splitlines()

digest=hashlib.sha256("\n".join(foreign).encode()).hexdigest()
assert len(foreign)==46,(len(foreign),digest)
assert digest=="d65d71d63a56b95aabfd61f33317b1f1f2b2a62a85ded8258c525b99a5e156ea",digest
tracked=[r for r in rows if not r.startswith("?? ")]
assert sorted(r[3:] for r in tracked)==sorted(["LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md","INDEX.md"]),tracked
print(json.dumps({"foreign_untracked_entries":len(foreign),"foreign_names_digest":digest,"digest_encoding":"sorted git-status ?? lines, joined LF without final LF","tracked_changes":tracked,"payload_inspection":False,"backup_completeness":"UNVERIFIED","pre_reboot_unsaved_state":"UNVERIFIED","ScratchDisk":"archive-dependent only","runtime_adjustment":"command-local serial Git index; repository configuration unchanged"},indent=2))
